message.content: ```python import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.soundgasm import SoundgasmProfileIE # Helper to create a fake webpage containing two audio links for a given profile id def fake_webpage(profile_id: str) -> str: return f''' Audio 1 Audio 2 ''' def test_profile_extractor_parses_multiple_entries(tmp_path): """Verify that the extractor returns a playlist with all matching audio URLs.""" ie = SoundgasmProfileIE() profile_id = "testuser" # Patch the downloader to return our fake webpage def fake_download(url, video_id): assert url == f"https://soundgasm.net/u/{profile_id}" assert video_id == profile_id return fake_webpage(profile_id) ie._download_webpage = fake_download result = ie._real_extract(f"https://soundgasm.net/u/{profile_id}") # The result should be a playlist with two entries assert result['entries'] is not None assert len(result['entries']) == 2 # Each entry should be a dict with the correct URL and IE name for entry, suffix in zip(result['entries'], ("audio1.mp3", "audio2.mp3")): assert entry['url'] == f"https://soundgasm.net/u/{profile_id}/{suffix}" assert entry['ie_key'] == 'Soundgasm' def test_profile_extractor_no_entries(tmp_path): """Verify that the extractor returns an empty playlist when no audio links are found.""" ie = SoundgasmProfileIE() profile_id = "emptyprofile" def fake_download(url, video_id): assert url == f"https://soundgasm.net/u/{profile_id}" assert video_id == profile_id # Return a page with no matching links return 'No audio here' ie._download_webpage = fake_download result = ie._real_extract(f"https://soundgasm.net/u/{profile_id}") # The playlist should contain zero entries assert result['entries'] is not None assert len(result['entries']) == 0 def test_profile_extractor_invalid_url_raises(): """Verify that an invalid URL raises a ValueError due to regex mismatch.""" ie = SoundgasmProfileIE() invalid_url = "https://soundgasm.net/invalid/path" with pytest.raises(ValueError): ie._real_extract(invalid_url) ```
